item.tib: che mchog dran pa yang gsang drag po'i rgyud dbang drag bsad las dgra bgegs phung byed
item.coloph: ces dbang drag me yi phreng ba las/ las sbyor drag po'i las byed tshe/ dgra bgegs dri ma rang gi kha rlang gang / ngang pa'i rgyal po'i chu dang 'o 'byed ltar/ so sor dbye byed khrus kyi yig chung 'di/ btsal ba'i byed po wer ya shing (shi)la des/ sa gzhi sngon po gos kyis bklubs pa'i dus/ tho shar dus su tsha lung rgar du bris// bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas nyi ma rang shar gnas kyi mkha' 'gro seng gdong phug nas spyan drangs shing / slar bsod nams can stobs kyi mnga' dbang sa bdag rgyal po'i pho brang drug zur rnam rgyal rdzong gi dbu rtse la shog ser bod yig du (tu) bsgyur ba grub pa'o//
